aboutPage.heading: Your Trusted Areca Nut Exporter
aboutPage.paragraph1: PT. Pakindo Impex Perkasa is an Indonesian trading and export/import company focused on connecting Indonesian products with international buyers.
aboutPage.paragraph2: Our approach is centered on clear communication, buyer-specific requirements, product coordination, documentation, and logistics support.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.copy: To become a trusted Indonesian trading and export/import partner for buyers seeking reliable products and long-term business relationships.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.copy: To make Indonesian products more accessible to international buyers through dependable sourcing, clear communication, and professional trade coordination.

slides.title: Your Trusted Areca Nut Exporter
slides.copy: PT. Pakindo Impex Perkasa connects international buyers with Indonesian products through reliable sourcing, quality coordination, export documentation, and logistics support.

slides.title: Indonesian Products. Global Markets. Reliable Trade.
slides.copy: From supplier coordination to export documentation and shipment support, we help international buyers navigate sourcing from Indonesia with clarity and confidence.

slides.title: From Inquiry to International Shipment
slides.copy: A structured six-step process takes your requirements from initial inquiry through specification confirmation, documentation, and loading — all the way to shipment.

trust.heading: Reliable Trade Starts With the Right Partner
trust.copy: International sourcing requires more than finding a product. Buyers need clear specifications, dependable coordination, suitable packaging, accurate documentation, and shipment support. Pakindo Impex Perkasa works to make the process clearer and more efficient from inquiry to shipment.

cards.title: Reliable Product Sourcing
cards.copy: We coordinate product sourcing according to buyer requirements and agreed specifications.

cards.title: Quality-Focused Handling
cards.copy: Product requirements are reviewed carefully so buyers and suppliers have a clear understanding of quality expectations.

cards.title: Competitive Export Pricing
cards.copy: We work with suppliers and buyers to develop quotations that reflect product specifications, quantities, packaging, and shipping requirements.

cards.title: Export & Logistics Support
cards.copy: We coordinate documentation, packaging, loading, and shipment-related requirements throughout the export process.

process.heading: A Clearer Export Process
process.description: Every international order can have different requirements. Share the details of your market and shipment, and we can review the appropriate sourcing and export approach.

steps.title: Send Your Requirements
steps.copy: Tell us the product, specification, quantity, packaging, destination, and other requirements.

steps.title: Product & Price Review
steps.copy: We review sourcing options and prepare a quotation based on the requested requirements.

steps.title: Specification Confirmation
steps.copy: Product quality, grade, packaging, quantity, and other commercial details are confirmed.

steps.title: Product Preparation
steps.copy: Product preparation and packaging are coordinated according to the agreed requirements.

steps.title: Documentation & Loading
steps.copy: Export documentation and shipment/loading arrangements are coordinated.

steps.title: International Shipment
steps.copy: The shipment proceeds according to the agreed trade and logistics arrangements.

items.question: What is your latest price for areca nut?
items.answer: Our prices vary depending on grade, quantity, and current market conditions. For accurate and latest pricing, please contact us directly via WhatsApp. We will respond quickly with details based on your specific requirements.

children.question: Does your price include shipping to my country?
children.answer: Yes, we can provide pricing based on your preferred Incoterms: FOB (from Indonesian port), CFR/CNF (includes shipping to your destination port), or CIF (includes shipping and insurance). Let us know your destination port, and we will calculate the best offer for you.

items.question: What payment terms do you accept?
items.answer: We accept secure international payment methods: T/T (Telegraphic Transfer) and L/C (Letter of Credit). Flexible terms can be discussed depending on order volume and cooperation.

children.question: What type of L/C do you accept?
children.answer: We accept an Irrevocable Letter of Credit at Sight, issued by a reputable international bank.

children.question: How does T/T payment work?
children.answer: Our standard terms: 50% advance payment after Proforma Invoice, and 50% balance after container loading (before shipment). We provide loading documentation and proof before final payment.

items.question: How do you ensure safe transactions?
items.answer: We prioritize transparency and long-term business relationships through real warehouse and processing activity, export experience to multiple countries, and clear documentation and communication. Buyers are welcome to visit or request video verification anytime.

children.question: What if I cannot visit Indonesia?
children.answer: No problem. Many of our buyers work with us remotely. We can provide product photos and videos, live video call from warehouse, and detailed specifications before shipment to ensure you receive products that match agreed specifications.

items.question: What products do you export?
items.answer: Our main export product: Areca Nut (Betel Nut) — Split, Whole, Roasted. We can also source other Indonesian agricultural products based on your request.

children.question: Can you supply products based on my market needs?
children.answer: Yes. We understand that each market has different quality and grading standards. We can adjust specifications based on your country requirements.

items.question: What is the HS Code for areca nut?
items.answer: Areca nut is generally classified under HS Code 0802. Please confirm with your local customs authority for specific regulations.

children.question: What about import duties in my country?
children.answer: Import duties depend on your country's customs regulations. We recommend checking with your local customs broker or authority.

items.question: Can I become your agent or partner in my country?
items.answer: Yes, we are open to long-term cooperation and partnerships. Let's discuss your market and potential collaboration via WhatsApp.

children.question: Can you supply directly to my customers?
children.answer: Yes, we can support your business by supplying directly. Please share your requirements and we will arrange accordingly.
